head: Duolingo event screens: option to skip them coming in December
dek: Duolingo says it will test a way to skip the event screens that appear after each lesson, such as avatar outfit events, starting with a small group of users next week. A wider rollout is planned for December.
details: A Duolingo representative announced the test in a post on the app's Reddit community, after users said the screens get in the way of learning. Today, finishing a lesson can mean tapping through several screens: milestone rewards, treasure chests, event games and, on the free plan, ads. Duolingo hasn't said how the opt-out will work or which platforms get it first.
where: Small test group from next week, wider rollout planned for December
means: If you tap through several screens after every lesson, you may soon be able to go straight to the next one.
todo: Nothing to do yet. Keep the app updated; the option should show up for more people in December.
thumb_words: DUOLINGO LETS YOU SKIP EVENT SCREENS
